lines.text: Cursor in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.
lines.spoken: Cursor in Spec With Code: plan, build, review.

lines.text: In your repo, run specweave init with the Cursor adapter. It adds AGENTS.md and eleven SpecWeave skills.
lines.spoken: In your repo, run spec weave init, with the Cursor adapter. It adds agents dot M D, and eleven spec weave skills.

lines.text: Open SpecWithCode, then Settings, Providers. Cursor is off by default: click Add provider, pick Cursor, click Next twice, then Add instance.
lines.spoken: Open Spec With Code, then Settings, Providers. Cursor is off by default: click Add provider, pick Cursor, click Next twice, then Add instance.

lines.text: Click Sign in, then Open browser, and approve. It runs on the Cursor SDK, so you don't need the Cursor CLI.
lines.spoken: Click Sign in, then Open browser, and approve. It runs on the Cursor S D K, so you don't need the Cursor C L I.

lines.text: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Cursor in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.
lines.spoken: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Cursor in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.

lines.text: Type a dollar sign, pick sw-increment, and describe the change. Cursor writes spec.md: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
lines.spoken: Type a dollar sign, pick S W increment, and describe the change. Cursor writes spec dot M D: acceptance criteria, and a task with its files and test.

lines.text: Then send sw-do. Cursor claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.
lines.spoken: Then send S W do. Cursor claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.

lines.text: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.
lines.spoken: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.

lines.text: Next, sw-done verifies and closes the increment.
lines.spoken: Next, S W done verifies and closes the increment.
